title: Double Stranded RNA Extraction by Cellulose
author: Vahid Jalali Javaran

steps.title: Grind leaf tissue in MiniG
steps.instruction: Weigh ~1.5 g fresh or frozen leaves and place them in a 50 ml capped centrifuge tube containing eight 8‑mm stainless steel balls (sterilized). Immerse the tube in liquid nitrogen for 5 min. Mount the tubes in a foam holder, transfer to the MiniG chamber, fix the tubes as instructed, and run MiniG at 1,500 rpm for 1 min. Repeat the same procedure with ~1 g bean leaves (Phaseolus vulgaris) in a separate 50‑ml capped tube with the same balls.

steps.title: Add extraction buffer and 2‑mercaptoethanol
steps.instruction: To each leaf sample add 12 ml extraction buffer and 120 µl 2‑mercaptoethanol; to the bean sample add 8 ml extraction buffer and 80 µl 2‑mercaptoethanol. Mix well.

steps.title: Clarify bean suspension
steps.instruction: Transfer 120 µl of the bean tissue suspension to each sample, shake for 40 min at 300 rpm, then centrifuge at 1,000 × g for 1 min at 10 °C to remove bubbles and large debris. Decant the supernatant into a new 50‑ml centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Precipitate nucleic acids with potassium acetate
steps.instruction: Add 12 ml 5.8 M potassium acetate to the supernatant, mix thoroughly, and centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 15 min at 10 °C.

steps.title: Isopropanol precipitation (pause point)
steps.instruction: Decant the supernatant through three layers of sterilized cheesecloth (optional) into a clean 50‑ml tube, add 16 ml 100 % isopropanol, mix, and incubate at –20 °C for 20 min.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet and initial centrifugation
steps.instruction: Resuspend the resulting pellet in 20 ml STE‑18, vortex, then centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C. Decant the supernatant into a new 50‑ml tube.

steps.title: Bind dsRNA to Sigmacell cellulose
steps.instruction: Add 2 ml Sigmacell cellulose suspension (containing 0.3 g cellulose) to the tube, vortex, shake for 15 min at 300 rpm at room temperature, centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 5 min at 20 °C, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash cellulose pellet with STE‑18
steps.instruction: First wash: resuspend pellet in 40 ml STE‑18, centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 5 min at 20 °C, discard supernatant. Second wash: add 20 ml STE‑18, repeat centrifugation, discard supernatant.

steps.title: Final nucleic acid centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 11,000 × g for 16 min at 4 °C and carefully discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Ethanol evaporation and resuspension
steps.instruction: Evaporate ethanol from the cellulose pellet at 40 °C for 15 min. Resuspend the pellet in 6 ml 1× STE, shake for 15 min at 300 rpm at room temperature, centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 8 min at 20 °C, and transfer the supernatant to a new 50‑ml tube (some cellulose particles are acceptable).

steps.title: dsRNA precipitation (pause point)
steps.instruction: Add 0.6 ml 3 M sodium acetate and 12 ml anhydrous alcohol to the supernatant, mix well, and incubate at –20 °C for 20 min.

steps.title: Pellet wash, dry and filter purification
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 11,000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, rinse the pellet twice with cold 70 % ethanol (if the pellet detaches, centrifuge again), air‑dry the pellet, resuspend in 300 µl TE or sterile water, load onto a 0.85 µm PES filter column (Sartorius Stedim Biotech), centrifuge at 13,000 × g for 30 s at room temperature, rinse the tube with 100 µl TE or water, pass the rinse through the same filter, centrifuge for 2 min, collect the total 400 µl eluate, and discard the filter.

steps.title: Store dsRNA or proceed to digestion
steps.instruction: Store the purified dsRNA at –80 °C (pause point) or continue directly to downstream digestion steps.
